description_en: Queries a list of live stream snapshot files by page
description_zh: 调用ListLiveSnapshotFiles获取实时截图文件列表，可分页获取
name: ListLiveSnapshotFiles

parameters.description_en: The ID of the snapshot job.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the snapshot job
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.description_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.
parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.description_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

- The maximum time range that can be specified is one day.
parameters.description_zh:
结束时间。UTC时间，格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。
- EndTime和StartTime之间的间隔不能超过1天。
parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

- The maximum time range that can be specified is one day
parameters.help_zh:
结束时间。UTC时间，格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。
- EndTime和StartTime之间的间隔不能超过1天
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.description_en: The number of results to return each time. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10.
parameters.help_en: The number of results to return each time. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description_en:
The sorting order. Default value: asc.

Valid values:

- asc: sorts the query results by creation time in ascending order.

- desc: sorts the query results by creation time in descending order.
parameters.help_en:
The sorting order. Default value: asc.

- desc: sorts the query results by creation time in descending order
parameters.name: sort_by
